pay_detail: Tuition $2,400 plus a $100 deposit credited to tuition (2026 prices). Housing and meal plans cost extra. Financial aid and scholarships exist.
notes: The director is Dr. Elizabeth Yao (elizyao@iu.edu). Check the 2027 dates and prices.
name: Summer Piano Academy (Jacobs School of Music)
org: Jacobs Academy, Jacobs School of Music, Indiana University Bloomington
what_you_do: A two-week summer program for serious young pianists with lessons and classes from master teachers. It has run for 39 years.
who_can_apply: Serious pianists ages 12 to 19. You must be able to practice several hours a day. You should play music that is early advanced to advanced. The director can admit exceptional students under 12. You must audition with a recording.
deadline_text: 2026 application, audition and financial aid forms were due March 2, 2026, with acceptance notices March 13. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Pay the $100 fee in the online sign-up form. Then upload a list of the music you play and two different pieces you play from memory. Send them as recordings to the Jacobs audition portal. Pay tuition only after you are accepted.
